audience: support leads and agents who handle customer conversations in Gladly

useCases.title: Pull up a customer and review their conversations
useCases.text: Find a customer by email, phone number or external id. Then list their conversations with topics, status and assignee, oldest first, so an agent sees the history.

useCases.title: Read the timeline of one conversation
useCases.text: Open a conversation and list its messages, emails, calls and notes in order. Ask the assistant for a short summary before you take over the case.

useCases.title: Check which tasks are still open for a customer
useCases.text: List the open tasks of a customer with assignee and due date. Use it to see which follow-ups are late before you answer the customer.

useCases.title: Map topics, inboxes and agents to names
useCases.text: Turn the topic, inbox and agent ids of a conversation into names. Use it to see who owns the case and where it sits.

useCases.title: Add an internal note after a customer contact
useCases.text: Write an internal note on a conversation, for example a call back request. Only agents see the note. Each call adds a new note.
